objective: Al terminar expresas arrepentimiento y crítica sobre el pasado con should have, shouldn't have, ought to have y could have.

warmup.prompt_es: 'Debería haber llamado', 'no tendría que haber dicho eso'. Con should have + participio miras atrás y valoras lo que hiciste o no hiciste.

lines.speaker: Lola
lines.text: I feel terrible. I shouldn't have shouted at my brother yesterday.
lines.es: Me siento fatal. No debería haberle gritado a mi hermano ayer.

lines.speaker: Lola
lines.text: He forgot my birthday, and I lost my temper. I should have stayed calm.
lines.es: Se olvidó de mi cumpleaños y perdí los nervios. Debería haberme calmado.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.text: You could have talked to him later. But you also should have known he was busy with exams.
lines.es: Podrías haber hablado con él después. Pero también deberías haber sabido que estaba ocupado con los exámenes.

lines.speaker: Lola
lines.text: I know. I ought to have been more understanding. Now he won't answer my calls.
lines.es: Lo sé. Tendría que haber sido más comprensiva. Ahora no contesta mis llamadas.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.text: You should have apologised immediately. It's not too late, though.
lines.es: Tendrías que haberte disculpado enseguida. No es demasiado tarde, aun así.

lines.speaker: Lola
lines.text: I wish I had called him last night. I could have saved a lot of stress.
lines.es: Ojalá lo hubiera llamado anoche. Podría haberme ahorrado mucho estrés.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.text: Send him a message now. You shouldn't have waited so long, but better late than never.
lines.es: Mándale un mensaje ahora. No deberías haber esperado tanto, pero más vale tarde que nunca.

md_es: | *should have + participio* | debería haber (no lo hice) | *I **should have called** her.* |
| *shouldn't have + participio* | no debería haber (lo hice) | *I **shouldn't have shouted**.* |
| *ought to have + participio* | = should have (más formal) | *I **ought to have been** more careful.* |
| *could have + participio* | podría haber (posibilidad no realizada) | *You **could have asked** me.* |
| *might have + participio* | quizá hubiera (posibilidad) | *It **might have been** worse.* |
**Para criticar a otros:** *You should have told me. · He shouldn't have said that.*
**Para arrepentirse:** *I should have studied more. · I wish I had studied more.* (wish + past perfect)
**Wish + past perfect** (arrepentimiento del pasado): *I wish I had called him.* = *I should have called him.*
**If only + past perfect:** *If only I had listened!*
**Preguntas:** *Should I have called her?* (poco usado) · *Why didn't you call me?* es más común.
| *Debería haber hecho eso (ayer).* | *I **should have done** that.* |
| *Podía haberlo hecho (y no lo hice).* | *I **could have done** it.* |
**Ojo:** ✘ *I should had called* · ✘ *I should of called* (es un error de escritura frecuente por la pronunciación /ˈʃʊdəv/) → ✔ *I should have called*. En voz hablada: *should've* /ˈʃʊdəv/.
